description:
Cast First Day of Class, allowing yourself to loot once due to learn and making it so whenever a creature enters the battlefield under your control this turn a +1/+1 counter will be put on it.
Cast Crimson Kobolds.
First Day of Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crimson Kobolds.
 Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, making it so the next time Crimson Kobolds dies this turn, it returns to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds, adding {2}.
Together Forever triggers, returning Crimson Kobolds to your hand.
Repeat.
